correctness.rationale: The actual Lagrange-interpolation derivative coefficients yield the 4-dimensional difference companion update and the two-step Floquet characteristic quartic. Independently reconstructed this quartic with exact SymPy arithmetic from interpolation nodes; its Cayley transformed quartic has q4=-32 P(r), P(r)=r^3(4u^3-8u^2-95u-127), u=r+1/r. All 13 and 19 coefficients of the two required Hurwitz-determinant polynomials were recomputed exactly and are positive. The cubic has a unique root above 2 and yields R*=6.2884027455921725. Positive q4 gives four interior Floquet roots; q4=0 leaves a simple -1 root with three strictly interior, while negative q4 gives exactly one real multiplier below -1. The constant solution remains a simple extra Floquet multiplier 1. This proves strict damping only for 1/R*<r<R*, and endpoint zero-stability for a fixed two-periodic grid, not arbitrary variable meshes.
